correctness.rationale: The angular density is sec² per fundamental period, and the exact Fourier expression is absolutely convergent. Twice integrating by parts uniformly in the Fourier index controls the Taylor remainder. Squaring and summing yields the n^-5 and n^-7 terms with rigorous O(n^-9) error; beta(5),beta(7) give the exact constants, and the analytic even-power Taylor structure proves the arbitrary-order hierarchy. Numerical quadrature and independent angular FFT passed for odd 3,5,7,9,11,15,21 and even 4,6,8,10, but finite checks do not replace proof.
